payload.body: cc is about to change two shared modules for ST0001 WP11 commit 3 (critic-rust's findings, vc's ruling 25f85e7): src/tree.rs (Person carries its picture, read from tree::person's existing About listing) and src/marker.rs (one marker-path helper for by_marker, sync's check and the plan's Add guard), plus src/plan.rs, src/workbook.rs, src/sync.rs and tests/cli.rs. The work happens in my own clone; nothing lands in the shared tree until the commit. If you are changing either shared module, tell me before I land.
